text:
Trading used to be a solo sport. In 2026 it's a team sport.

A serious trading setup today needs:
🧠 Strategy: the research and the edge
💻 Technology: code, APIs, monitoring and uptime
⚙️ Execution: a registered broker, clean routing and fair costs
🛡 Risk and compliance: limits, kill switches and regulatory hygiene
💼 Capital efficiency: using collateral and margin intelligently

Very few individuals are world-class at all five.

That's why I keep coming back to the same idea: it's an era of collaboration, not competition. A great strategist with weak infrastructure leaves money on the table. Great infrastructure without a real edge is just expensive plumbing.

If you're strong in one of these areas and want to connect with people who complement you, let's talk. I'm building a network of serious traders, developers and market professionals.

Which of the five is your strongest? 👇

#AlgoTrading #FnO #OptionsTrading #NSE #StockMarketIndia #Collaboration #TradingCommunity #QuantTrading

—
Darshil Shah | DDS Capital
